_source: Envelope {id, ok, result, _meta:{runtimeId}} is documented in .matrixkoder/inbox/research/orca-cli-reference.md line 22. The inner result of run-create and task-create is NOT shown in that reference (usage text only, lines 1762-1990), so result.run.id and result.task.id are modelled on the documented task and run fields in orca-orchestration-bus.md §1 (tasks.id, tasks.run_id, tasks.status). Replace with a recorded receipt after the first live call (SPIKE A6). The stub script derives ids from --retry-request, which models Orca replaying the same receipt for the same request id.
